capabilities: Open a searchable badge picker by typing !!
Filter badges by type, label, or search keys
Insert selected badges in Badges plugin syntax
Edit the badge list in settings
disambiguation: It does not display or render badges itself; it only inserts text and needs the Badges plugin to render them.
extras: Default badge list is Korean-language confidence badges (with entries like CLAUDE and ADR); README includes a Korean summary and manual install steps.
intentEvidence: Install and enable the Badges plugin to render the inserted badges.
problem: Using the Badges plugin requires memorizing its [!!type:label] syntax and badge types, which this picker replaces with typed autocomplete.

relations.evidence: Type !! to pick a badge from a searchable list and insert it in the Badges plugin syntax.

summary: Searchable badge picker triggered by typing !! that inserts badges in Badges plugin syntax, with an editable badge list in settings.
